summary: Backend-only testing of financial system, Stripe key storage, and payout logic. All 31 tests passed. Key features verified: platform settings routes (GET/PUT /api/platform-settings/stripe), pending payout balance calculation, backfill_transaction_types migration, and SuperAdmin form state variables. One critical bug found: stripeController.js confirmAtDoorPayment() inserts wrong fields into financial_transactions.

critical.issue: confirmAtDoorPayment() in stripeController.js (lines 1393-1406) inserts financial_transactions with wrong schema fields: 'type: sale' (column doesn't exist, should be 'transaction_type: at_door_payment'), 'net_amount' (should be 'organizer_net'), 'payment_method', 'payment_source' (non-existent columns), 'status: completed' (should be 'succeeded'). Error is silently swallowed in try/catch so at-door Stripe payments produce NO financial transaction record.
critical.fix: Replace with: { transaction_type: 'at_door_payment', gross_amount: grossAmount, platform_fee: platformFee, stripe_fee: 0, organizer_net: grossAmount - platformFee, currency: currency.toLowerCase(), status: 'succeeded', payout_status: 'pending', stripe_payment_intent_id: paymentIntentId, event_id: ..., registration_id: ... }

minor.issue: checkPlatformSettingsTable() helper function always returns true because Supabase client returns errors in {data, error} object (doesn't throw exceptions) but the function uses try/catch. This is dead code - routes use correct inline checks - but the helper is misleading.

GET_platform_settings_stripe.notes: Route exists, returns 401 without auth. Code review confirms: when table doesn't exist (Supabase error includes 'does not exist'), tableExists=false and falls back to env vars. When table exists but no row, tableExists=true. Response includes publishableKey, masked keys, isConfigured, isFromDB, tableExists, environment fields.

PUT_platform_settings_stripe.notes: Route exists, returns 401/403 without auth. Code review confirms: checks for table existence before upsert. Returns 503 with setupRequired:true and SQL instructions when platform_settings table doesn't exist (error includes 'does not exist' or 'schema cache').

GET_admin_platform_payouts_pending.notes: Route exists, returns 401 without auth. Code review confirms: only counts 'succeeded' transactions with platform_fee>0. Only filters by date when a prior completed payout exists (all transactions when no prior payout). Subtracts in-flight (scheduled/pending) payouts. Uses Math.max(0,...) to prevent negatives. Response includes totalCollected, scheduledAmount, transactionCount, periodStart, periodEnd.

POST_admin_run_migration_backfill.notes: Route exists, returns 401/403 without auth. Code review confirms: backfill_transaction_types case checks if 'type' column exists. Returns SQL instructions with success:false, columnExists:false, and ALTER TABLE SQL when column missing. Falls back to JS-based backfill when column exists.

financial_transactions_type_field.notes: stripeWebhookController.js and registrationController.js correctly use 'transaction_type' (no bare 'type:' field). stripeController.js confirmAtDoorPayment() has 'type: sale' bug (line 1396) in the at-door Stripe payment path.

superadmin_form_state_variables.notes: platformStripePublishableKey, platformStripeSecretKey, platformStripeWebhookSecret state variables exist. Form inputs bound to these variables. loadPlatformSettings() called when activeTab === 'settings'. Submission uses correct variable names.

critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: stripeController.js confirmAtDoorPayment() - 'type: sale' field does not exist in financial_transactions table (column is 'transaction_type'). Also uses net_amount, payment_method, payment_source, status: 'completed' - none matching the actual schema. Error silently swallowed so at-door Stripe payments create NO financial records.

DEAD CODE: checkPlatformSettingsTable() in platformSettingsRoutes.js always returns true because it uses try/catch but Supabase doesn't throw - it returns {data, error}. This helper is never called by routes (routes do inline checks correctly) but the misleading function should be removed or fixed.
NOTE: server.js loadPlatformSettingsFromDB() correctly handles missing platform_settings table on startup - confirmed working.
NOTE: All other financial_transaction inserts (webhook, registration, refund flows) correctly use 'transaction_type' field and proper schema.
action_items: CRITICAL: Fix stripeController.js confirmAtDoorPayment() (lines 1393-1406) - replace wrong financial_transactions insert with correct schema fields: transaction_type='at_door_payment', gross_amount, platform_fee, stripe_fee, organizer_net, currency, status='succeeded', payout_status='pending', stripe_payment_intent_id
LOW: Remove or fix the dead checkPlatformSettingsTable() helper in platformSettingsRoutes.js (lines 36-43) that always returns true

at_door_financial_transaction_bug.root_cause: The confirmAtDoorPayment() function appears to have been written independently from the main ticket sale financial transaction logic, using a different schema (possibly from an older version of the table). It uses 'type', 'net_amount', 'payment_method', 'payment_source' which don't exist in the financial_transactions table. The try/catch silently swallows the error, hiding the bug in production.
at_door_financial_transaction_bug.impact: At-door Stripe card payments (POST /api/stripe/at-door/confirm-payment) will NOT create financial transaction records. This means: (1) at-door sales are invisible to the platform fee payout calculation, (2) organizer net earnings reports miss at-door payments, (3) the pending payout calculation for platform fees will undercount.
at_door_financial_transaction_bug.reproduction: Process an at-door payment using the Stripe kiosk flow. Check financial_transactions table - no record will be created for that payment.
at_door_financial_transaction_bug.mitigation: Replace the insert with correct schema: transaction_type='at_door_payment', gross_amount, platform_fee (from application_fee_amount), stripe_fee=0, organizer_net=grossAmount-platformFee, currency=currency.toLowerCase(), status='succeeded', payout_status='pending', stripe_payment_intent_id
